description: This Java class implements a MongoDB command listener that logs execution details and records timing metrics for database commands, integrating with Kamon monitoring.

classes.name: KamonCommandListener
classes.description: A listener for MongoDB command events that logs and measures command durations, sending metrics to Kamon.

methods.name: KamonCommandListener
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the listener with a specific metric name.

methods.name: commandStarted
methods.description: Logs the start of a MongoDB command.

methods.name: commandSucceeded
methods.description: Logs successful command execution and records elapsed time.

methods.name: commandFailed
methods.description: Logs failed command execution and records elapsed time.

methods.name: recordElapsedTime
methods.description: Records the elapsed time of a command to Kamon metrics.
